summary: Generic exact compaction based only on merging equal local structural/signature states cannot guarantee a fixed exponent independent of the original polynomial exponent K. DEAD/COPY/DELAY normalization removes representation inflation but leaves a T=N^K useful skeleton in the adversarial distinct-state control. Lossy hashing creates collisions without proving semantic equivalence.
limit: This is not a lower bound on SAT or on all implementations. It only defeats generic representation-level compaction of the supplied code A.
